meals.name: Sticky soy-ginger pork stir-fry with charred broccoli
steps: Start 1½ cups rice. Slice 1½ lb pork loin into thin strips and toss with 1 Tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp cornstarch.
Whisk the sauce: 3 Tbsp soy sauce, 2 Tbsp honey, 1 Tbsp rice vinegar, 1 Tbsp sesame oil, 3 minced garlic cloves, 1 Tbsp grated ginger, ¼ tsp red pepper flakes and 3 Tbsp water.
Heat 1 Tbsp oil in a large skillet over high heat. Cook 1½ lb broccoli florets 4–5 minutes, until charred in spots and crisp-tender; splash in 2 Tbsp water at the end and transfer to a plate.

Add 1 Tbsp oil and sear the pork in two batches, 2–3 minutes each, until browned and 145°F. Return everything to the pan, pour in the sauce and toss 1 minute until glossy. Serve over rice with sliced green onions.

meals.name: Smoky sheet-pan chicken fajitas with lime crema
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Slice 1½ lb chicken breast into strips, 3 red bell peppers into strips and 1 large onion into wedges.
Toss everything with 3 Tbsp oil, 1 Tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp oregano, 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper. Spread on a large sheet pan in one layer.
Roast 20–25 minutes, stirring once, until the vegetables char at the edges and the chicken reaches 165°F. Squeeze 1 lime over the pan.
Stir ½ cup sour cream with the juice of half a lime, a pinch of salt and a dash of hot sauce. Warm the tortillas and fill with the fajita mix and a spoonful of crema.

meals.name: Brown-butter Italian sausage and butternut squash pasta
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss 1½ lb peeled, cubed butternut squash with 1 Tbsp olive oil, ½ tsp salt and ¼ tsp pepper; roast 25 minutes until browned and tender.
Meanwhile brown 1 lb Italian sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, 8–10 minutes until no pink remains (160°F). Move to a plate.

Cook 12 oz pasta in salted water; save 1 cup pasta water. In the same skillet melt 3 Tbsp butter over medium heat and cook 2–3 minutes until nutty brown. Add 3 sliced garlic cloves, 1½ tsp dried sage and ½ tsp red pepper flakes for 30 seconds.
Add the pasta, sausage, squash, ½ cup grated parmesan and splashes of pasta water; toss until saucy. Season with salt and plenty of pepper.

meals.name: Lemon-oregano salmon with smoky roasted sweet potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Cut 2 lb sweet potatoes into wedges and toss with 2 Tbsp olive oil, 1½ tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder and ¾ tsp salt. Roast 15 minutes.
Pat 1½ lb salmon dry and cut into 4 pieces. Rub with 1 Tbsp olive oil, 1½ tsp oregano, the zest of the lemon, 2 minced garlic cloves, ½ tsp salt and ¼ tsp pepper.
Push the potatoes aside, add the salmon to the pan and roast 12–14 minutes more, until the salmon flakes and reaches 145°F and the potatoes are tender.
Melt 1 Tbsp butter with the lemon juice and a pinch of oregano; spoon over the salmon before serving.

meals.name: Cajun shrimp and peppers over cheddar grits
steps: Bring 2 cups milk and 2 cups broth to a simmer. Whisk in 1 cup quick grits and cook, stirring, 5–7 minutes until thick. Off the heat stir in 1½ cups (6 oz) shredded sharp cheddar, 1 Tbsp butter, salt and pepper.
Toss 1¼ lb peeled shrimp with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, ½ tsp thyme, ¼–½ tsp cayenne and ½ tsp salt.
Heat 1 Tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high and cook 1 sliced red pepper 3 minutes. Add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side until pink and opaque (145°F).
Add 2 Tbsp butter, 2 minced garlic cloves, a squeeze of lemon and a few dashes of hot sauce; toss to coat. Spoon over the grits with sliced green onions.

meals.name: Smoky roasted squash and black bean tacos with avocado crema (meatless)
steps: Thinly slice ½ onion and cover with ½ cup cider vinegar, ½ cup hot water, 1 tsp sugar and ½ tsp salt for a quick pickle.

Heat oven to 425°F. Toss 2 lb cubed butternut squash with 2 Tbsp oil, 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin, ¼ tsp cayenne and ¾ tsp salt; roast 25 minutes, then drizzle with 1 Tbsp honey and roast 5 minutes more.
Warm 2 cans drained black beans in a skillet with 1 Tbsp oil, ½ tsp cumin, ½ tsp garlic powder and a splash of water; mash lightly.
Mash 2 avocados with ½ cup sour cream, the lime juice and a pinch of salt. Fill warm tortillas with beans, squash, avocado crema and pickled onions.

meals.name: Honey-smoked pulled pork sliders with tangy carrot slaw
steps: Heat oven to 300°F. Mix 2 Tbsp brown sugar, 1 Tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp chili powder, 2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp cumin, 2 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper; rub all over a 3½ lb bone-in pork shoulder.
Put the pork in a covered Dutch oven with ½ cup water and roast 4–4½ hours, until it shreds easily (well past the safe 145°F, about 200°F). Shred and skim off the fat.
Simmer ½ cup ketchup, ¼ cup cider vinegar, 3 Tbsp honey, 1 Tbsp mustard, 1 Tbsp Worcestershire and hot sauce to taste for 5 minutes; toss with the pork and ½ cup of the pan juices.
Toss the coleslaw mix and 1 cup shredded baby carrots with ⅓ cup mayo, 1 Tbsp cider vinegar, 1 tsp sugar, salt and pepper. Pile pork and slaw on the split Hawaiian rolls.

meals.name: Crispy honey-soy pork belly rice bowls with quick-pickled carrots
steps: Grate or matchstick 2 cups baby carrots and toss with ¼ cup rice vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and ½ tsp salt; set aside. Start 1½ cups rice.
Cut 1 lb pork belly into ½-inch pieces. Cook in a dry skillet over medium heat, stirring, 15–18 minutes until golden and crisp (well past 145°F); pour off all but 1 Tbsp fat.
Add 3 minced garlic cloves for 30 seconds, then 3 Tbsp soy sauce, 2 Tbsp honey, 1 Tbsp rice vinegar and ¼ tsp red pepper flakes; bubble 1–2 minutes until sticky.
Fry 4 eggs in the second pan. Build bowls with rice, pork belly, pickled carrots and a fried egg; finish with a drizzle of sesame oil and green onions.

meals.name: Garlic-herb Italian sausage, potato and green bean skillet
steps: Cut 2 lb russet potatoes into ¾-inch cubes and microwave in a covered bowl with 2 Tbsp water for 6 minutes to par-cook.
Brown 1 lb bulk Italian sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, until no pink remains and 160°F, 7–8 minutes. Move to a plate.
Add 1 Tbsp olive oil and the potatoes with 1 tsp smoked paprika and ½ tsp salt; cook 8–10 minutes, turning, until crisp. Add 12 oz trimmed green beans and 2 Tbsp water, cover and steam 4 minutes.
Stir in 2 Tbsp butter, 4 minced garlic cloves, 1½ tsp Italian seasoning and ¼ tsp red pepper flakes for 1 minute; return the sausage, squeeze in lemon and top with ¼ cup parmesan.

meals.name: Garlic-parmesan baked wings with crispy roasted Brussels sprouts
steps: Heat oven to 425°F with a rack set on a foil-lined sheet pan. Pat 3 lb wings very dry and toss with 1 Tbsp baking powder, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1½ tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper.
Bake the wings 25 minutes, flip, and bake 20–25 minutes more until crisp and at least 165°F. On a second pan, roast 1½ lb halved Brussels sprouts with 2 Tbsp olive oil and ½ tsp salt for 25 minutes.
Melt 3 Tbsp butter with 4 minced garlic cloves and ¼ tsp red pepper flakes for 1 minute. Toss the hot wings with the garlic butter, ½ cup grated parmesan and 1 tsp dried parsley.
Drizzle the sprouts with 1 Tbsp balsamic vinegar and serve alongside the wings.
